The UPR is a UN Human Rights Council process in which the human rights records of member states are reviewed by other member countries every five years. Another challenge is now emerging with equal urgency: the need to develop infrastructure that shapes everyday life - hospitals, education, housing, and water and sanitation. The scale of the needs illustrates the magnitude of the challenge. Nearly 400 million people in sub-Saharan Africa still lack access to basic drinking water services, while more than 98 million children, adolescents and young people of primary and secondary school age are out of school. Ces dernières avaient été rompues il y a un an et demi après des sanctions de l'Union européenne contre des chefs militaires rwandais, dans le cadre du conflit entre la République démocratique du Congo et l'AFC/M23 soutenu par le Rwanda. stories.title: Using AI to ‘talk to animals’ might make us feel clever – but what, if anything, does it do for them?
stories.summary: Vivek Thakker/The Guardian Using AI to ‘talk to animals’ might make us feel clever – but what, if anything, does it do for them? As animal behaviorists increasingly use AI in their research, they grapple with how to wield the technology responsibly I’m sitting in a small boat in Shark Bay, Australia, eavesdropping on a conversation between some of Earth’s most intelligent beings. The motor is off, the turquoise sea is glassy, and Stephanie King and I are motionless, transfixed by the whistles, clicks and squeezy, whirring noises made by the dolphins swimming below us. If anyone could tell me what these big-brained social mammals are saying, it would be her. Based at the University of Bristol, she co-leads Shark Bay Dolphin Research , one of the longest-running wild dolphin research projects in the world.

The report says the Trump administration’s cuts to programs such as US Agency for International Development (USAID), as well as the Covid-19 pandemic and rising costs of living globally have brought “new urgency” for the need to reform healthcare in the region. The report, titled A Sovereign Future For Health , was created by the Accra Reset, a global health initiative led by John Dramani Mahama, Ghana’s president, that believes countries in Africa and the wider global south should have greater control over their health development rather than being dependent on aid from western countries and international institutions.
